## Problem / motivation

What problem does this solve? Who is affected (operator, verifier, admin, integration
client)? Is it blocking a real workflow?

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope / impact

- [ ] Backend (API / pipeline / validation)
- [ ] Frontend (UI)
- [ ] Data model / migration
- [ ] Integration (LRMS / DILRMP / GIS)
- [ ] Docs / tooling

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or references (e.g. a real record shape or a DoLR
requirement) about the feature request here.
